tickets.title: Prepare source evidence and headless design proposals with adversarial cases
gate_cmd:
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/design/headless-2026-11-13')
d=json.loads((p/'packet.json').read_text())
assert d['schema_version']==1 and d['status']=='proposed' and d['baseline_commit']=='41f2cb8568b53fac984e1114d7342eef540bb6d5'
assert d['runtime_changed'] is False and d['paid_runs'] is False and d['contracts_frozen'] is False
assert set(d['decisions'])=={'D01','D02','D03','D04','D05','D06','D09','D10'}
assert set(d['work_items'])=={'W01','W02'}
for name in ('README.md','temporal-storage.md','authority-history.md','build-gate-protocol.md','mechanics-fixtures.md','source-delta.md'):
 text=(p/name).read_text()
 assert len(text)>1500,name
for path in d['code_references']:assert Path(path).is_file(),path
cases=json.loads((p/'cases.json').read_text())
assert cases['status']=='declarative_not_executed'
ids=set()
coverage=set()
assert len(cases['cases'])>=24
for c in cases['cases']:
 assert c['id'] not in ids and c['id'];ids.add(c['id'])
 assert set(c['decisions'])<=set(d['decisions']) and c['decisions'];coverage.update(c['decisions'])
 assert c['given'] and c['when'] and c['then'] and c['invariant']
 assert c['verification_status']=='not_executed'
assert coverage==set(d['decisions'])
s=json.loads((p/'source-evidence.json').read_text())
assert s['schema_version']==1 and s['private_databases_accessed'] is False
assert len(s['sources'])>=3
for x in s['sources']:
 assert x['repository'] and x['baseline_identity'] and x['identity_kind']
 assert x['refresh_status'] in ('verified_same_tree','verified_changed_tree','unavailable','local_code_verified')
 assert x['limitations']
road=json.loads(Path('docs/roadmap/system.json').read_text())
assert len(road['decisions'])==11 and len(road['work_items'])==17
for x in road['decisions']:assert x['status']=='ready_for_design'
assert 'docs/design/headless-2026-11-13/README.md' in Path('SYSTEM_ROADMAP.md').read_text()
print('PASS headless packet structure, decision coverage, fixture references and non-execution labels')
